description: This PHP source file defines a class 'SugarWebServiceImplv4_1' that implements web service methods for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, including retrieving related records and modified relationship data. It extends another class and incorporates licensing and documentation comments.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceImplv4_1
classes.description: Implements SOAP web service methods for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, handling retrieval of related records and synchronization data, with version 4.1 enhancements.

methods.name: get_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves related record sets for a given module and record ID, including related fields, with support for pagination and ordering.

methods.name: get_modified_relationships
methods.description: Fetches relationships modified within a specified date range, used for synchronization, with filtering for deleted records and access controls.
